(Image credit: Rockstar Games) {alert('Link copied')}).catch(err => {console.error('Failed to copy: ', err)})" data-platform="copy_link" data-action="" class="font-ui-heading py-2 text-sm text-neutral-700 hover:bg-neutral-100 transition-colors no-underline block cursor-pointer border-0 bg-transparent w-full text-left normal-case" aria-label="Copy link" role="menuitem" data-analytics-id="article-social" analytics-label="utility-bar-social-share-copy-link" analytics-name="utility-bar-secondary" data-mrf-recirculation="article-social"> Copy link Facebook X Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Rockstar Games and PlayStation are hosting a festival dedicated to the music of GTA 6 on the game's launch weekend, featuring the game's composer, Justice. It's wild to say, but here we are: GTA 6 is releasing next week. 13 years of waiting, GTA Online microtransaction spending, and "we got x before GTA 6" jokes, and the game is almost out. It's safe to say that GTA 6 will be the biggest single video game launch of all time when it finally arrives – and I'd be shocked if that weren't the case. At the very least, Rockstar and PlayStation are treating it as the biggest video game release of all-time because when has a game ever had a music festival dedicated to its launch? Announced today , as part of its mission to take over Miami – including the Miami Heat rebranding into Vice City Heat – Grand Theft Auto 6 The Festival is coming to Miami on November 21, two days after the game finally launches. The festival will feature a number of artists from the GTA 6 soundtrack and will have two stages at Mana Wynwood in Miami. Latest Videos From GamesRadar+ Watch full video here: Acts include Travis Scott, Don Toliver, Kodak Black, and Sofaygo under the "Cactus Jack presents" label, as well as Cardi B – with those presumably being the two headline acts for each stage. Also featured are Metro Boomin and a DJ set by Justice – the French duo responsible for the original score of GTA 6. Potential attendees will have to enter their names into a lottery system, which closes tomorrow at 4pm ET before a draw at 7pm ET. Then on Wednesday at 12pm ET, you'll be able to purchase tickets if you were successful. Granted, I get the feeling a lot of people who are interested will be too busy playing a big video game that will be released a couple of days before.
